method: actual final GLB, every exported baked key, selected weighted sole vertices and toe-weighted patch vertices skinned from the candidate mesh

scale.interpretation: The candidate already carries one top-level uniform reference-scale wrapper. The near-unity factor shown here reconciles the measured candidate-world hip height with the 2.75 m target and must not be applied a second time.

l.sequence: metatarsal lift with toe patch loaded, followed by toe release
